development_baseline.name: v19 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 1.0 * v12 development residual on matched rows outside LIRF, then (1 - 0.7) * that + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all (out-of-sample per fold) on every row outside LIRF, then 0.3 * v9 + 0.7 * ens_v21_lgb_lirf3 on matched LIRF non-population rows with ordinary clocks, floored; reproduces 330.302 / 269.512 / 191.878 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025 (runs/adsb_v21_v2/selection.json, lirf_ens3_70). The baseline uses the recorded single-seed v12 development residual (parent v12_development_residuals); the residual model refitted here is the same single booster, so the reproduction candidate is exact.

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

ens_v20_bag_q_all.rule: the incumbent committee (existing, hash-bound, not rebuilt)

ens_v21_lgb_lirf3.rule: the v19 LIRF LightGBM group (existing, hash-bound, not rebuilt): mean of lgb_lirf_s31, lgb_lirf_cap_s32, lgb_lirf_nm_s33

ens_v22_cat_lirf4.rule: mean of finite predictions of all four LIRF-inclusive CatBoosts

ens_v22_cat_lirf_label.rule: mean of the two label-target LIRF-inclusive CatBoosts

ens_v22_cat_lirf_nm.rule: mean of finite predictions of the two NM-residual LIRF-inclusive CatBoosts (NaN where the clock is missing)

ens_v22_lirf_half.rule: one half of the v19 LightGBM group mean plus one half of ens_v22_cat_lirf4

ens_v22_lirf_q.rule: one quarter of the v19 LightGBM group mean plus three quarters of ens_v22_cat_lirf4 (the incumbent committee's quarter / three-quarter rule)

ensembles.missing_members: if a learner variant fails to complete on all three folds it is dropped from every ensemble that lists it and the drop is recorded in the selection; no other change
ensembles.tool: tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py (per-row mean of finite member predictions, fold by fold); nested means are built by listing members with multiplicities that reproduce the weighted group means exactly (ens_v22_lirf_q: the LightGBM group once and the CatBoost group three times); every label-target learner predicts every row and every NM-residual learner predicts every row with the clock

execution.learner_fits_on_workers: tools/launch_adsb_learners.py --config configs/adsb_v22_v1.json (16 threads per fit, one variant per worker, folds in sequence: seasonal, forward, refit)

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)
external_data.v19_features: label-free features derived from the same adsb.lol surface positions (ODbL), stand names and runway names; docs/adsb_v19_screen/README.md items A-C

ens_v20_bag_q_all.description: the incumbent committee as declared above

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.official_rank: not recorded (the user's standing rule: no leaderboard checks)
incumbent.recipe: v19 = the v18 recipe everywhere ((1 - 0.7) * (v9 + 1.0 * v12 ADS-B residual on matched rows outside LIRF) + 0.7 * ens_v20_bag_q_all on every row outside LIRF, floored) except on matched LIRF non-population rows with |NM proxy| and |schedule interval| under six hours (scope lirf_nonpop_matched), where the prediction is 0.3 * v9 + 0.7 * ens_v21_lgb_lirf3 (mean of three LIRF-inclusive LightGBMs); every other LIRF row is v9 (configs/adsb_v21_v2.json, lirf_ens3_70; uploaded 18:19 UTC 18 September 2026)

learner_common.catboost_base: configs/timeline_v1.json catboost block (depth 8, learning rate 0.055, l2 10, Bernoulli 0.8, rsm 0.9, max_ctr_complexity 1, one_hot_max_size 10, early stopping 200) with the overrides above and a 20,000-round cap
learner_common.excluded_airports: none for the v22 learners (LIRF included); the LIRF fill population (LIRF, no AOBT_3/LOBT clock, no aircraft type: exactly the v9 mixture's rows, 449 of the 506,751 development rows, 383 ranking rows) is left out of fitting and early stopping through the runner's --exclude-population option; every row is still predicted (the NM-residual learners predict NaN on rows without the clock, which are outside every blend scope)
learner_common.features: timeline bundle CORE + FLOWN + SURFACE (276) + 27 ADS-B features from data/external/adsblol/matches (matches2_*, stands.parquet; hashes recorded in every run record); no v19 features (null inside LightGBM in v20)
learner_common.folds: seasonal and forward (out-of-sample fold predictions), refit on the eleven 2025 months at the median best iteration
learner_common.settings: configs/timeline_v1.json (lightgbm / catboost blocks; parameter overrides above)
learner_common.target: label (cat_lirf_ctr2_s34, cat_lirf_ctr3_s35) or nm_residual = label minus the NM clock proxy (cat_lirf_ctr2_nm_s36, cat_lirf_ctr3_nm_s37)

cat_lirf_ctr2_nm_s36.note: as cat_lirf_ctr2_s34 with --target nm_residual (label minus the NM clock; rows without the clock are neither fitted nor predicted), seed 20260936 (arcw3)

cat_lirf_ctr2_s34.note: the cat_ctr2 recipe (timeline_v1 CatBoost, max_ctr_complexity 2, 20,000-round cap) fitted on every airport with the LIRF fill population excluded, label target, seed 20260934 (arcw1)

cat_lirf_ctr3_s35.note: the cat_ctr3 recipe (max_ctr_complexity 3), otherwise as cat_lirf_ctr2_s34, seed 20260935 (arcw2)

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after adsb_v21_v2 (docs/adsb_v21/README.md, docs/adsb_v21_v2/README.md): three LightGBMs fitted on every airport with only the LIRF fill population excluded, blended at 0.7 on matched LIRF non-population rows with ordinary clocks, improved v18 by 0.74% (July 2025, LIRF 94% matched) and 0.16% (November 2025, 66% matched), mean 0.30%, and shipped as v19 (official 241.1789, -0.095% vs v18; the ranking's LIRF rows in scope are January 2026's, 80% matched). The gain grew monotonically with the blend weight over 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7, the NM-residual target was the strongest single learner (lirf_nm_50 -0.28%), and no CatBoost has been fitted with LIRF rows. In adsb_v15-v17 the LightGBM-to-combination-CatBoost step (max_ctr_complexity 2 / 3, 20,000-round cap) was worth two to three times the LightGBM gain on the non-LIRF rows. This round fits four combination CatBoosts with LIRF's ordinary rows (label and NM-residual targets, ctr complexity 2 and 3) and tests them, alone and together with the v19 LightGBM group, on the same lirf_nonpop_matched scope at weights 0.7 / 0.85 / 1.0. No v22 learner had been fitted and no candidate scored before this declaration; the deep audit of 18 September (docs/audit_20260918/README.md) is the ranked-lever record.

residual_model.applies_to: the residual model is exactly v12's (nb feature set, matched rows outside LIRF, weight 1.0, single booster); each candidate then blends the result with ens_v20_bag_q_all at 0.7 on every row outside LIRF (the incumbent's blend), and adds a second blend on the lirf_nonpop_matched scope with one v21 / v22 table: value = (1 - w) * v9 + w * table there (the table REPLACES the incumbent's LIRF blend, it is not stacked on it); every other LIRF row keeps v9 exactly.
residual_model.blend: post-hoc convex combination with the extra table adsb_full (candidate_values in tools/run_adsb_v11.py); a NaN learner value leaves the row unblended
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.all_no_lirf: every departure at any airport except LIRF: a blend scope only (unmatched rows there become (1 - w) * v9 + w * adsb_full)
scopes.lirf_nonpop: every LIRF departure outside the v9 mixture's fill population (airport == LIRF and not population): a blend scope only; rows there are (1 - w) * v9 + w * <table>, the population rows stay v9
scopes.lirf_nonpop_matched: LIRF departures outside the fill population with a matched ADS-B surface segment (adsb_matched == 1) whose NM proxy and schedule interval are both under six hours in absolute value (label-free, available on the ranking rows): the LIRF blend scope after the amendment; every other LIRF row stays v9
scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF): the residual model's training and prediction scope (exactly v12)

residual_model.seed_bag: none: v21_v1 measured the five-seed bag at -0.002% on every month (runs/adsb_v21_v1/selection.json, candidate ens_v20_bag_q_all_70); the residual is the single declared booster again, exactly as in v12-v20

configuration.selection: For each candidate, RMSE of the blended prediction on each held-out month versus the v19 development prediction. A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v19 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0), its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.9998 (0.02%), and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v19 lies below zero on every month where the candidate differs from v19 on at least one row (January 2025 has no LIRF row in scope, LIRF being unmatched that month, so the interval condition acts on July and November). Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v19 (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v19. lirf_ens3_70 reproduces the incumbent and is a check. Ratios to v9 and per-airport tables are descriptive only.
